_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): rows 34-L-switch, 34-L-reopen, 34-L-restart. No model call: two scripted turns (send + /sendas). Keep locks SO-V2734 Wren; a mid-story setUserAvatar to SO-V2734 Tamsin (persona_auto_lock pinned off, so the chat lock stays) must raise persona-switch in the drawer's #so-setup with 'Switch back' ([data-so=setup-fix]); clicking it restores Wren and clears the finding (34-L-switch). The reload verb is the close-and-reopen (the runner reopens the sandbox chat): no start page, the lock holds in memory and on the server copy, and #so-your-character holds no button/select/input (34-L-reopen). Restart after unlocking the chat re-offers the pane and picking Tamsin writes a new lock on the server copy (34-L-restart). Cleanup restores the selected persona and auto-lock and removes the SO-V2734 personas. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-persona-switch.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model lane.

requires.why: scripted turns only; the persona writes need a lane
